LanguageData.TM_RangerBreakthrough.label: Breakthrough Hunt
LanguageData.TM_RangerBreakthrough.description: With your bonded animal within 12 cells, mark an enemy and up to two nearby foes within bow range (maximum 30 cells). Aim for 5 seconds and fire 6 arrows over 20 seconds at 70% bow damage. The animal covers two hostile weapon hits, absorbing up to 25 damage each. Move speed falls by 20% during the volley. Base cost: 60% stamina, cooldown: two days. Interrupted preparation costs 6% stamina.
